questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements about the development and representation of a river system: 1. Runoff may pass from rills and rivulets to gullies, streams and a river. 2. A river mouth is the route along which the river flows, while a channel is where it enters another water body. 3. A printed river map should be checked for present political names and correct river courses before using every label as a scored fact. Which statements are correct?
questions.question_te: నదీ వ్యవస్థ అభివృద్ధి, దాని map representation గురించి కింది వాక్యాలను పరిశీలించండి: 1. Runoff చిన్న Rills, Rivulets నుంచి Gullies, Streamsగా పెరిగి Riverగా ఏర్పడవచ్చు. 2. River Mouth అంటే నది ప్రవహించే మార్గం; Channel అంటే మరో water bodyలో కలిసే ప్రదేశం. 3. Printed river mapలోని ప్రతి labelను scored factగా వాడే ముందు current political names, correct river coursesతో verify చేయాలి. సరైనవి ఏవి?
option_explanations_en: Statement 2 reverses channel and mouth.
Correct: statements 1 and 3 are sound; statement 2 reverses the definitions.
Statement 1 is also correct, while statement 2 is false.
Statement 2 makes this combination incorrect.
questions.explanation_en: A channel is the natural route through which river water flows; the mouth is where the river enters a sea, lake or another river. Printed maps are learning aids, but their labels need verification when names, boundaries or river-course placement may be dated or simplified.
questions.explanation_te: నది నీరు ప్రవహించే సహజ మార్గం Channel; నది సముద్రం, సరస్సు లేదా మరో నదిలో కలిసే ప్రదేశం River Mouth. Printed maps learning aids అయినా, names, boundaries, river-course placement dated లేదా simplifiedగా ఉండవచ్చు కాబట్టి verify చేయాలి.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Match the term with its precise meaning: A. Drainage basin; B. Water divide; C. Tributary; D. Distributary. 1. Branch flowing away from the main channel; 2. Elevated boundary between adjacent basins; 3. Land area draining to a river and its tributaries; 4. Stream joining a larger river.
questions.question_te: పదాన్ని దాని ఖచ్చితమైన అర్థంతో సరిపోల్చండి: A. Drainage Basin; B. Water Divide; C. Tributary; D. Distributary. 1. Main Channel నుంచి బయటకు విడిపోయే branch; 2. Adjacent basinsను వేరు చేసే elevated boundary; 3. River, tributariesకు runoff అందించే మొత్తం land area; 4. పెద్ద నదిలో కలిసే stream.
option_explanations_en: Basin and divide, tributary and distributary are reversed.
Correct: A–3, B–2, C–4 and D–1.
None of the four terms is correctly matched.
All four relationships are incorrect.
option_explanations_te: నాలుగింటిలో ఏ term సరైన meaningతో match కాలేదు.
questions.explanation_en: A catchment or drainage basin is an area contributing runoff to a specified river system; usage of 'watershed' varies by scale and discipline. A divide is the elevated boundary, while an interfluve is the land between neighbouring streams.
questions.explanation_te: Catchment లేదా Drainage Basin ఒక specified river systemకు runoff అందించే land area. Watershed పదం scale, disciplineను బట్టి మారవచ్చు. Divide elevated boundary; neighbouring streams మధ్య landను Interfluve అంటారు.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements: 1. An antecedent river predates uplift and maintains its course by incision. 2. Antecedent and superimposed drainage are exact synonyms. 3. Indus, Sutlej and Brahmaputra are standard Trans-Himalayan systems. 4. Consequent drainage follows the regional slope, whereas rejuvenation means renewed erosional energy after uplift or base-level change. Which are correct?
questions.question_te: కింది వాక్యాలను పరిశీలించండి: 1. Antecedent River upliftకు ముందే course ఏర్పరచుకొని, incision ద్వారా దానిని కొనసాగిస్తుంది. 2. Antecedent, Superimposed Drainage పూర్తిగా synonyms. 3. Indus, Sutlej, Brahmaputra standard Trans-Himalayan systems. 4. Consequent Drainage regional slopeను అనుసరిస్తుంది; Rejuvenation uplift లేదా base-level change తరువాత renewed erosional energyను సూచిస్తుంది. సరైనవి ఏవి?
option_explanations_en: Statement 2 is false because antecedent and superimposed drainage have different origins.
Statements 1 and 3 are also correct, while 2 is false.
Correct: 1, 3 and 4 distinguish the concepts accurately.
Statement 2 makes this combination incorrect.
option_explanations_te: 2 తప్పు: Antecedent, Superimposed drainage origins వేరు.
questions.explanation_en: Antecedent rivers retain an older course while relief rises; superimposed rivers inherit a course from a former cover surface and cut into underlying structures. Consequent describes slope-controlled origin, while rejuvenation describes renewed erosional activity, not river origin.
questions.explanation_te: Antecedent River relief uplift అయినప్పటికీ పాత courseను incisionతో కొనసాగిస్తుంది. Superimposed River former cover surfaceపై ఏర్పడిన courseను underlying structuresపై కొనసాగిస్తుంది. Consequent originలో slope controlను, Rejuvenation renewed erosionను సూచిస్తాయి.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Which comparison of Himalayan and Peninsular rivers is the most accurate?
questions.question_te: Himalayan Rivers, Peninsular Rivers మధ్య అత్యంత ఖచ్చితమైన comparison ఏది?
options_en: All Himalayan rivers are seasonal and every Peninsular river is perennial
Himalayan systems generally have larger basins and mixed snow-rain supply; Peninsular rivers flow over older terrain and show several structure-controlled patterns
Both groups have identical valley forms, basin sizes and drainage patterns
Peninsular drainage contains only the Narmada and Tapi systems
options_te: అన్ని Himalayan Rivers seasonal; ప్రతి Peninsular River perennial
Himalayan systems సాధారణంగా larger basins, snow–rain supply కలిగి ఉంటాయి; Peninsular Rivers older terrainపై ప్రవహించి అనేక structure-controlled patterns చూపుతాయి
రెండు groupsలో valley forms, basin sizes, drainage patterns పూర్తిగా ఒకేలా ఉంటాయి
Peninsular drainageలో Narmada, Tapi మాత్రమే ఉంటాయి
option_explanations_en: This reverses the dominant perennial-seasonal pattern and ignores exceptions.
Correct: it captures the dominant source, basin, terrain and pattern differences without making them absolute.
The groups differ substantially in age, relief, valley form and drainage pattern.
Godavari, Krishna, Mahanadi, Cauvery and Pennar are also major Peninsular systems.
option_explanations_te: ఇది dominant perennial–seasonal patternను reverse చేసి exceptionsను విస్మరిస్తుంది.
సరైనది: source, basin, terrain, pattern differencesను absolute ruleగా మార్చకుండా చెబుతుంది.
Age, relief, valley form, drainage patternలో ముఖ్యమైన differences ఉన్నాయి.
Godavari, Krishna, Mahanadi, Cauvery, Pennar కూడా major Peninsular systems.
questions.explanation_en: The printed 12-row table is best used as a dominant-pattern comparison. Himalayan rivers include the Indus, Ganga and Brahmaputra systems; major Peninsular systems include Godavari, Krishna, Mahanadi, Cauvery, Pennar, Narmada and Tapi. Local exceptions remain important.
questions.explanation_te: Printed 12-row tableను dominant-pattern comparisonగా చదవాలి. Himalayan examples: Indus, Ganga, Brahmaputra. Peninsular examples: Godavari, Krishna, Mahanadi, Cauvery, Pennar, Narmada, Tapi. Local exceptionsను గుర్తుంచుకోవాలి.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements about basin-size statistics: 1. The book classifies a major basin as above 20,000 km², a medium basin as 2,000–20,000 km² and a minor basin as below 2,000 km². 2. Printed counts and water-share percentages can be used without identifying their dataset year. 3. The printed 77:23 Himalayan-Peninsular drainage-area share should be held unscored until its dataset is identified. Which statements are correct?
questions.question_te: Basin-size statistics గురించి కింది వాక్యాలను పరిశీలించండి: 1. పుస్తకం Major Basinను 20,000 km² కంటే ఎక్కువగా, Medium Basinను 2,000–20,000 km²గా, Minor Basinను 2,000 km² కంటే తక్కువగా వర్గీకరిస్తుంది. 2. Printed basin counts, water-share percentagesకు dataset year అవసరం లేదు. 3. Printed 77:23 Himalayan–Peninsular drainage-area shareకు dataset గుర్తించే వరకు scored factగా వాడకూడదు. సరైనవి ఏవి?
option_explanations_en: Statement 3 is also correct as an evidence rule.
Correct: the thresholds are preserved, while unsourced counts and shares remain unscored.
Statement 1 is correct and Statement 2 is false.
Statement 2 is false because the figures are dataset-sensitive.
option_explanations_te: సరైనది: thresholdsను preserve చేసి, unsourced counts/sharesను unscoredగా ఉంచాలి.
questions.explanation_en: Threshold definitions can be retained as the book's classification. Counts, shares and water-resource percentages depend on the agency, year and basin definitions, so they require a dated official source before scoring.
questions.explanation_te: Threshold definitionsను book classificationగా preserve చేయవచ్చు. Counts, shares, water-resource percentages agency, year, basin definitionsపై ఆధారపడతాయి; scored MCQకు dated official source అవసరం.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements about the Ganga system: 1. The Bhagirathi and Alaknanda meet at Devprayag, after which the name Ganga is used. 2. The Ganga enters the plains near Haridwar and its main Bangladesh distributary is called the Padma. 3. Every length and basin-area figure is independent of the chosen source and measurement convention. Which statements are correct?
questions.question_te: Ganga system గురించి కింది వాక్యాలను పరిశీలించండి: 1. Devprayag వద్ద Bhagirathi, Alaknanda కలిసిన తరువాత Ganga అనే పేరు వాడతారు. 2. Ganga Haridwar సమీపంలో plainsలోకి ప్రవేశిస్తుంది; Bangladeshలో ప్రధాన distributaryను Padma అంటారు. 3. Length, basin-area figures ఏ source, measurement convention వాడినా ఒకేలా ఉంటాయి. సరైనవి ఏవి?
option_explanations_en: Correct: 1 and 2 describe the course; 3 ignores measurement conventions.
Statement 1 is also correct, while 3 is false.
Statement 2 is correct and 3 is false.
Statement 3 makes this combination incorrect.
option_explanations_te: సరైనది: 1, 2 courseను వివరిస్తాయి; 3 measurement conventionsను విస్మరిస్తుంది.
questions.explanation_en: The printed basin map is useful for locating the major tributary network, but every bank-side classification and measurement must be checked against a dated basin source. Bhagirathi-Ganga length conventions are especially important.
questions.explanation_te: Printed basin map major tributary networkను locate చేయడానికి useful. కానీ bank-side classification, measurementsను dated basin sourceతో verify చేయాలి. Bhagirathi–Ganga length convention ముఖ్యమైనది.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Which evidence treatment of the Ganga profile is correct?
questions.question_te: Ganga profileకు సరైన evidence treatment ఏది?
options_en: Use every printed rank, pollution category and funding amount permanently without a year
Retain the 2,525 km length with its CWC convention, correct the Indian basin area to the dated CWC value, and keep changing ranks, funds and pollution stretches source-dated
Replace all official figures with the oldest textbook value
Treat a campaign name as proof that every river stretch has the same pollution status
options_te: Printed rank, pollution category, funding amount అన్నింటినీ year లేకుండా permanent factsగా వాడాలి
2,525 km lengthను CWC conventionతో ఉంచి, Indian basin areaను dated CWC valueతో సరిచేసి, changing ranks, funds, pollution stretchesను source-datedగా ఉంచాలి
అన్ని official figuresను oldest textbook valueతో replace చేయాలి
ఒక campaign name ఉన్నంత మాత్రాన ప్రతి river stretchకు ఒకే pollution status ఉందని భావించాలి
option_explanations_en: Ranks, funding and polluted stretches are time- and definition-sensitive.
Correct: stable measurements retain their convention, while changing claims remain dated and sourced.
Official dated evidence takes precedence over an older conflicting print value.
Pollution status is assessed by stretch, parameter and reporting cycle.
option_explanations_te: సరైనది: stable measurements conventionతో; changing claims dated, sourcedగా ఉండాలి.
Older conflicting print valueకంటే dated official evidenceకు ప్రాధాన్యం.
Pollution status stretch, parameter, reporting cycle ఆధారంగా మారుతుంది.
questions.explanation_en: CWC 2024 gives a Ganga length of 2,525 km under its stated convention and an Indian basin area of 838,803 km². The Ganga was declared the National River in 2008. Namami Gange funding periods and pollution-control lists must always retain their date and source.
questions.explanation_te: CWC 2024 stated convention ప్రకారం Ganga length 2,525 km; Indian basin area 838,803 km². Gangaను 2008లో National Riverగా ప్రకటించారు. Namami Gange funding periods, pollution-control listsకు date, source తప్పనిసరి.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Match the confluence with its rivers: A. Vishnuprayag; B. Nandaprayag; C. Rudraprayag; D. Devprayag. 1. Bhagirathi-Alaknanda; 2. Dhauliganga-Alaknanda; 3. Mandakini-Alaknanda; 4. Nandakini-Alaknanda.
questions.question_te: Confluenceను riversతో సరిపోల్చండి: A. Vishnuprayag; B. Nandaprayag; C. Rudraprayag; D. Devprayag. 1. Bhagirathi–Alaknanda; 2. Dhauliganga–Alaknanda; 3. Mandakini–Alaknanda; 4. Nandakini–Alaknanda.
option_explanations_en: The four confluences are mismatched.
Correct: A–2, B–4, C–3 and D–1.
None of the four pairs is correct.
All four assignments are incorrect.
questions.explanation_en: Karnaprayag, the fifth Panch Prayag, is the Pindar-Alaknanda confluence. Prayagraj is the Ganga-Yamuna confluence traditionally associated with the invisible Saraswati; it is not one of the five Alaknanda Panch Prayag sites.
questions.explanation_te: Fifth Panch Prayag అయిన Karnaprayag వద్ద Pindar–Alaknanda కలుస్తాయి. Prayagraj వద్ద Ganga–Yamuna confluence; traditional invisible Saraswati association ఉంది. అది Alaknanda Panch Prayagలో భాగం కాదు.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements: 1. The Yamuna rises in the Yamunotri glacier region and joins the Ganga at Prayagraj. 2. Chambal, Sind, Betwa and Ken are major Peninsular-side tributaries of the Yamuna. 3. The Chambal is associated with the Mhow-Janapav highland region and is known for ravines and badland topography. Which are correct?
questions.question_te: కింది వాక్యాలను పరిశీలించండి: 1. Yamuna Yamunotri glacier regionలో పుట్టి Prayagraj వద్ద Gangaలో కలుస్తుంది. 2. Chambal, Sind, Betwa, Ken Yamunaకు ముఖ్యమైన Peninsular-side tributaries. 3. Chambal Mhow–Janapav highland regionతో సంబంధం కలిగి, ravines, badland topographyకు ప్రసిద్ధి. సరైనవి ఏవి?
option_explanations_en: Statement 3 is also correct.
Statement 1 is also correct.
Statement 2 is also correct.
Correct: all three relationships are accurate.
questions.explanation_en: The Yamuna follows the Delhi-Agra corridor before joining the Ganga. Exact source elevation and length should retain an official series. The Chambal crosses Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan and joins the Yamuna in Uttar Pradesh.
questions.explanation_te: Yamuna Delhi–Agra corridor గుండా ప్రవహించి Gangaలో కలుస్తుంది. Exact source elevation, lengthకు official series అవసరం. Chambal Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan గుండా ప్రవహించి Uttar Pradeshలో Yamunaలో కలుస్తుంది.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Which method best avoids hierarchy errors while studying the Yamuna-Ganga tributary network?
questions.question_te: Yamuna–Ganga tributary networkను చదివేటప్పుడు hierarchy errorsను నివారించే ఉత్తమ పద్ధతి ఏది?
options_en: Place Banas, Kali Sindh, Parbati, Shipra, Sind, Betwa, Ken, Tons, Son and Damodar in one undifferentiated list
Record each river's immediate receiving channel and bank, and keep unrelated current-affairs items such as the Ujjain Vedic clock outside the river hierarchy
Treat every tributary of a tributary as a direct Ganga tributary
Infer every confluence solely from the state in which a river rises
options_te: Banas, Kali Sindh, Parbati, Shipra, Sind, Betwa, Ken, Tons, Son, Damodar అన్నింటినీ ఒక undifferentiated listలో పెట్టడం
ప్రతి river immediate receiving channel, bankను నమోదు చేసి, Ujjain Vedic Clock వంటి unrelated current-affairs itemsను river hierarchy బయట ఉంచడం
Tributary of a tributary అయిన ప్రతి riverను direct Ganga tributaryగా భావించడం
River పుట్టిన state ఆధారంగా ప్రతి confluenceను infer చేయడం
option_explanations_en: This merges different hierarchy levels and basin relationships.
Correct: immediate receiver and bank preserve the network structure; unrelated current affairs stay separate.
A sub-tributary is not automatically a direct Ganga tributary.
Source state does not determine the downstream confluence hierarchy.
option_explanations_te: ఇది different hierarchy levels, basin relationsను కలిపేస్తుంది.
సరైనది: immediate receiver, bank network structureను preserve చేస్తాయి; unrelated current affairs వేరుగా ఉంటాయి.
Sub-tributary automaticగా direct Ganga tributary కాదు.
Source state downstream confluence hierarchyను నిర్ణయించదు.
questions.explanation_en: Banas is a Chambal tributary; Kali Sindh, Parbati and Shipra belong to the wider Chambal-Malwa drainage context and need exact receiver-level care. Sind, Betwa and Ken are right-bank Yamuna tributaries. Tons/Tamas, Son and Damodar must also be placed by their immediate receiver.
questions.explanation_te: Banas Chambal tributary. Kali Sindh, Parbati, Shipra wider Chambal–Malwa drainage contextలో ఉన్నాయి; exact receiverను వేరు చేయాలి. Sind, Betwa, Ken Yamuna right-bank tributaries. Tons/Tamas, Son, Damodarను కూడా immediate receiver ఆధారంగా ఉంచాలి.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements about northern tributaries of the Ganga: 1. Ramganga, Gomti, Ghaghara, Gandak, Kosi and Mahananda belong to the important northern or left-bank tributary group. 2. Gomti flows through Lucknow and Jaunpur before joining the Ganga near the Ghazipur area. 3. Ghaghara is associated upstream with the Karnali system, but Sarayu-Sharda names must be used with reach-specific care. Which are correct?
questions.question_te: Ganga northern tributaries గురించి కింది వాక్యాలను పరిశీలించండి: 1. Ramganga, Gomti, Ghaghara, Gandak, Kosi, Mahananda ముఖ్యమైన northern/left-bank tributary groupకు చెందుతాయి. 2. Gomti Lucknow, Jaunpur గుండా ప్రవహించి Ghazipur ప్రాంతం సమీపంలో Gangaలో కలుస్తుంది. 3. Ghaghara upstreamలో Karnali systemతో సంబంధం కలిగి ఉంది; Sarayu–Sharda namesను reach-specificగా జాగ్రత్తగా వాడాలి. సరైనవి ఏవి?
option_explanations_en: Statements 2 and 3 are also correct.
Statement 3 is also correct.
Statement 1 is also correct.
Correct: all three statements are accurate with the naming caution.
option_explanations_te: సరైనది: naming cautionతో మూడు statements accurate.
questions.explanation_en: The tributaries should be organised by their immediate receiving channel and bank rather than memorised as a flat list. Regional names in the Ghaghara-Karnali-Sarayu-Sharda context vary by reach and source tradition.
questions.explanation_te: Tributariesను flat listగా కాకుండా immediate receiving channel, bank ఆధారంగా organize చేయాలి. Ghaghara–Karnali–Sarayu–Sharda contextలో regional names reach, source traditionను బట్టి మారవచ్చు.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements: 1. Gandak-Narayani and Kosi descend from Nepal toward the Bihar plain; the Kosi has built a mobile alluvial-fan system. 2. 'Saptakosi' is a tributary-system convention, so its seven-stream list requires verified names and spellings. 3. Mahananda reaches the Ganga-Padma system after flowing through the Darjeeling foothill and north Bengal-Bihar region. 4. The Indus rises in the Tibetan plateau region near the Kailash-Manasarovar area and reaches the Arabian Sea through Pakistan. Which are correct?
questions.question_te: కింది వాక్యాలను పరిశీలించండి: 1. Gandak–Narayani, Kosi Nepal నుంచి Bihar plain వైపు దిగుతాయి; Kosi mobile alluvial-fan systemను నిర్మించింది. 2. ‘Saptakosi’ tributary-system convention; seven-stream listలో names, spellings verify చేయాలి. 3. Mahananda Darjeeling foothill, north Bengal–Bihar region గుండా Ganga–Padma systemకు చేరుతుంది. 4. Indus Tibetan Plateauలో Kailash–Manasarovar ప్రాంతం సమీపంలో పుట్టి Pakistan గుండా Arabian Seaకు చేరుతుంది. సరైనవి ఏవి?
option_explanations_en: Statements 3 and 4 are also correct.
Statement 4 is also correct.
Statement 1 is also correct.
Correct: all four statements are accurate with the stated source cautions.
option_explanations_te: సరైనది: stated source cautionsతో నాలుగు statements accurate.
questions.explanation_en: The Kosi's channel mobility and alluvial fan help explain recurrent flood risk. The Saptakosi name represents a tributary network, while the Mahananda and Indus belong to different receiving systems and should not be flattened into the same hierarchy.
questions.explanation_te: Kosi channel mobility, alluvial fan recurrent flood riskను అర్థం చేసుకోవడానికి కీలకం. Saptakosi ఒక tributary network convention. Mahananda, Indus వేర్వేరు receiving systemsకు చెందుతాయి; ఒకే hierarchyలో కలపకూడదు.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements about the Indus system: 1. The Indus crosses Ladakh and then flows through Pakistan to the Arabian Sea. 2. Tarbela Dam is on the Indus in Pakistan, but changing superlatives and dimensions require a current source. 3. Bank-side classification of tributaries can be copied from a schematic map without considering downstream direction. 4. Printed international boundaries and river lengths may depend on map scale and segment definition. Which statements are correct?
questions.question_te: Indus system గురించి కింది వాక్యాలను పరిశీలించండి: 1. Indus Ladakh గుండా ప్రవహించి Pakistan ద్వారా Arabian Seaలో కలుస్తుంది. 2. Tarbela Dam Pakistanలో Indusపై ఉంది; changing superlatives, dimensionsకు current source అవసరం. 3. Downstream directionను చూడకుండా schematic map నుంచి tributary bank classificationను నేరుగా copy చేయవచ్చు. 4. Printed international boundaries, river lengths map scale, segment definitionపై ఆధారపడవచ్చు. సరైనవి ఏవి?
option_explanations_en: Statement 4 is also correct.
Correct: 1, 2 and 4 are sound; bank designation in 3 must use downstream orientation.
Statement 1 is correct, but 3 is false.
Statement 3 makes this combination incorrect.
option_explanations_te: సరైనది: 1, 2, 4 sound; 3లో bank designationకు downstream orientation అవసరం.
questions.explanation_en: Important upper and western Indus tributaries include Shyok, Nubra, Gilgit, Zanskar, Kabul, Kurram and Gomal. Their bank assignment must be made relative to the direction of the main river, not merely from page position on a map.
questions.explanation_te: Upper/western Indus tributariesలో Shyok, Nubra, Gilgit, Zanskar, Kabul, Kurram, Gomal ఉన్నాయి. Bank assignmentను map page positionతో కాకుండా main river downstream directionతో నిర్ణయించాలి.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Match the river with the correct source or formation relationship: A. Jhelum; B. Chenab; C. Beas; D. Sutlej. 1. Chandra-Bhaga confluence; 2. Verinag and Wular Lake course; 3. Rohtang-Beas Kund region; 4. Tibetan source region and entry through Himachal Pradesh.
questions.question_te: Riverను correct source/formation relationshipతో సరిపోల్చండి: A. Jhelum; B. Chenab; C. Beas; D. Sutlej. 1. Chandra–Bhaga confluence; 2. Verinag, Wular Lake course; 3. Rohtang–Beas Kund region; 4. Tibetan source region, Himachal Pradesh ద్వారా entry.
option_explanations_en: Jhelum, Chenab, Beas and Sutlej are all mismatched.
Correct: A–2, B–1, C–3 and D–4.
None of the four pairs is correct.
All four relationships are displaced.
option_explanations_te: Jhelum, Chenab, Beas, Sutlej అన్నీ mismatched.
questions.explanation_en: The Jhelum rises at Verinag and passes through Wular Lake; the Chenab is formed by Chandra and Bhaga. Ravi rises in the Himachal Himalaya, while Beas and Sutlej have the distinct source relations shown in the table. Exact lengths and elevations require one consistent dataset.
questions.explanation_te: Jhelum Verinag వద్ద పుట్టి Wular Lake గుండా ప్రవహిస్తుంది; Chenab Chandra, Bhaga కలయిక. Ravi Himachal Himalayaలో పుడుతుంది. Beas, Sutlej source relations tableలో వేరు. Exact lengths, elevationsకు consistent dataset అవసరం.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Match the traditional Punjab doab with its river pair: A. Sind Sagar; B. Chaj; C. Rachna; D. Bari. 1. Chenab-Ravi; 2. Indus-Jhelum; 3. Ravi-Beas; 4. Jhelum-Chenab.
questions.question_te: Traditional Punjab Doabను river pairతో సరిపోల్చండి: A. Sind Sagar; B. Chaj; C. Rachna; D. Bari. 1. Chenab–Ravi; 2. Indus–Jhelum; 3. Ravi–Beas; 4. Jhelum–Chenab.
option_explanations_en: Correct: A–2, B–4, C–1 and D–3.
All four doabs are assigned to the wrong pairs.
None of the four relationships is correct.
The doab sequence is displaced.
questions.explanation_en: A doab is the land between two rivers. Bist or Jalandhar Doab lies between Beas and Sutlej. The Sutlej is joined by the Beas in Punjab, continues into Pakistan, and supports the Bhakra-Nangal project system upstream in India.
questions.explanation_te: Doab అంటే రెండు rivers మధ్య land. Bist/Jalandhar Doab Beas–Sutlej మధ్య ఉంటుంది. Sutlej Punjabలో Beasను స్వీకరించి Pakistan వైపు ప్రవహిస్తుంది; Indiaలో Bhakra–Nangal project systemతో సంబంధం కలిగి ఉంది.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Which sequence correctly follows the Brahmaputra's changing regional names and course?
questions.question_te: Brahmaputra regional names, courseను సరైన sequenceలో చూపేది ఏది?
options_en: Jamuna in Tibet → Tsangpo in Assam → Siang in Bangladesh
Yarlung Tsangpo in Tibet → Siang/Dihang in Arunachal Pradesh → Brahmaputra in Assam → Jamuna in Bangladesh
Brahmaputra in Tibet → Indus in Assam → Padma in Bangladesh
Siang in Tibet → Ganga in Assam → Meghna in Bangladesh
options_te: Tibetలో Jamuna → Assamలో Tsangpo → Bangladeshలో Siang
Tibetలో Yarlung Tsangpo → Arunachal Pradeshలో Siang/Dihang → Assamలో Brahmaputra → Bangladeshలో Jamuna
Tibetలో Brahmaputra → Assamలో Indus → Bangladeshలో Padma
Tibetలో Siang → Assamలో Ganga → Bangladeshలో Meghna
option_explanations_en: These names are assigned to the wrong reaches.
Correct: this follows the standard regional sequence.
Indus and Padma belong to different systems or reaches.
Ganga and Meghna do not replace the Brahmaputra in Assam.
questions.explanation_en: After the Siang/Dihang receives the Dibang and Lohit systems, the main river is known as the Brahmaputra in Assam. Length and basin figures must state their territorial segment. Majuli is a dynamic river island shaped by erosion, deposition and channel migration, so rank and area claims need a date and definition.
questions.explanation_te: Siang/Dihangకు Dibang, Lohit systems కలిసిన తరువాత Assamలో main riverను Brahmaputra అంటారు. Length, basin figuresకు territorial segment చెప్పాలి. Majuli erosion, deposition, channel migration వల్ల మారే dynamic river island; rank, area claimsకు date, definition అవసరం.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Which statement applies the correct method to the Brahmaputra tributary table?
questions.question_te: Brahmaputra tributary tableకు correct methodను వర్తింపజేసే statement ఏది?
options_en: Bank side is determined by north at the top of the printed page, and all project statuses are permanent
Bank side is determined while looking downstream; Teesta is transboundary but not the full India-Bangladesh boundary; tributaries, parks and projects need individual current verification
Dibang, Lohit and Burhi Dihing are one channel with interchangeable names
The 1787 Teesta course change proves that every present boundary follows the river
options_te: Printed pageపై north ఆధారంగా bank side నిర్ణయించి, project statuses అన్నీ permanentగా భావించాలి
Downstream వైపు చూస్తూ bank side నిర్ణయించాలి; Teesta transboundary అయినా మొత్తం India–Bangladesh boundary కాదు; tributaries, parks, projectsను individually current sourcesతో verify చేయాలి
Dibang, Lohit, Burhi Dihing ఒకే channel; names interchangeable
1787 Teesta course change వల్ల ప్రతి present boundary riverనే follow చేస్తుందని నిర్ధారించవచ్చు
option_explanations_en: Bank side uses downstream orientation, and project status changes over time.
Correct: this preserves bank logic, corrects the boundary overstatement and dates dynamic facts.
These are distinct rivers or tributary systems with separate courses.
A historical course change does not define the entire international boundary.
option_explanations_te: Bank sideకు downstream orientation అవసరం; project status timeతో మారుతుంది.
సరైనది: bank logic preserve చేసి, boundary overstatementను correct చేసి, dynamic factsను date చేస్తుంది.
ఇవి separate courses గల distinct rivers/systems.
Historical course change మొత్తం international boundaryని define చేయదు.
questions.explanation_en: Northern/right-bank tributary systems include Subansiri, Kameng, Manas, Sankosh, Raidak, Jaldhaka and Torsa; important southern or eastern systems include Dibang, Lohit, Burhi Dihing, Dhansiri and Kopili. The Teesta changed course substantially after the 1787 flood and now joins the Jamuna system in Bangladesh.
questions.explanation_te: Northern/right-bank systemsలో Subansiri, Kameng, Manas, Sankosh, Raidak, Jaldhaka, Torsa ఉన్నాయి. Southern/eastern systemsలో Dibang, Lohit, Burhi Dihing, Dhansiri, Kopili ఉన్నాయి. Teesta 1787 flood తరువాత course మార్చి Bangladeshలో Jamuna systemలో కలుస్తుంది.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements: 1. The Barak rises in the Manipur hills, crosses southern Assam and contributes to the Surma-Meghna system in Bangladesh. 2. The 2022 Kushiyara arrangement and Feni water-use claims are timeless physical-geography facts requiring no treaty source. 3. The Feni is a transboundary river in the Tripura-Chattogram region. Which are correct?
questions.question_te: కింది వాక్యాలను పరిశీలించండి: 1. Barak Manipur hillsలో పుట్టి southern Assam గుండా Bangladeshలో Surma–Meghna systemలో భాగమవుతుంది. 2. 2022 Kushiyara arrangement, Feni water-use claimsకు treaty source అవసరం లేని timeless physical-geography facts. 3. Feni Tripura–Chattogram regionలోని transboundary river. సరైనవి ఏవి?
option_explanations_en: Correct: 1 and 3 are stable geography; Statement 2 wrongly removes the need for treaty-level dating.
Statement 2 is false.
Statement 1 is correct, while 2 is false.
Statement 2 makes this combination incorrect.
option_explanations_te: సరైనది: 1, 3 stable geography; 2 treaty-level datingను తప్పుగా తొలగించింది.
questions.explanation_en: Stable course facts should be separated from current water-sharing arrangements. The Kushiyara memorandum and Feni border-use arrangements must retain their date, scope and treaty or government source.
questions.explanation_te: Stable course factsను current water-sharing arrangements నుంచి వేరు చేయాలి. Kushiyara memorandum, Feni border-use arrangementsకు date, scope, treaty/government source అవసరం.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements about Peninsular drainage: 1. Most large Peninsular rivers flow east, while Narmada and Tapi are prominent west-flowing exceptions. 2. The Godavari rises near Trimbakeshwar and flows east for about 1,465 km. 3. The Godavari basin includes parts of Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh and Odisha; exact shares need a dated basin report. Which are correct?
questions.question_te: Peninsular drainage గురించి కింది వాక్యాలను పరిశీలించండి: 1. Most large Peninsular Rivers eastకు ప్రవహిస్తాయి; Narmada, Tapi prominent west-flowing exceptions. 2. Godavari Trimbakeshwar సమీపంలో పుట్టి సుమారు 1,465 km eastకు ప్రవహిస్తుంది. 3. Godavari basin Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha భాగాల్లో విస్తరించింది; exact sharesకు dated basin report అవసరం. సరైనవి ఏవి?
option_explanations_en: Statement 3 is also correct.
Statement 1 is also correct.
Statement 2 is also correct.
Correct: all three statements are accurate and appropriately sourced.
option_explanations_te: సరైనది: మూడు statements accurate, appropriately sourced.
questions.explanation_en: Damodar, Mahanadi, Godavari, Krishna, Pennar and Cauvery are key east-flowing systems. State-share percentages may change with dataset method and should not be inferred from a state list.
questions.explanation_te: Damodar, Mahanadi, Godavari, Krishna, Pennar, Cauvery key east-flowing systems. State-share percentages dataset methodను బట్టి మారవచ్చు; state list నుంచి infer చేయకూడదు.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Which statement about the lower Godavari is scientifically and cartographically safest?
questions.question_te: Lower Godavari గురించి scientifically, cartographically safest statement ఏది?
options_en: Every printed local distributary route is permanent and needs no current map
Below Dhawaleswaram the principal Gautami and Vasishta branches form the delta; smaller branch names and district routes should be checked against a current official map
The Godavari has no distributaries because it is a Peninsular river
Its title Dakshin Ganga proves every printed basin percentage is current
options_te: Printed local distributary route ప్రతి ఒక్కటి permanent; current map అవసరం లేదు
Dhawaleswaram దిగువన principal Gautami, Vasishta branches deltaను నిర్మిస్తాయి; smaller branch names, district routesను current official mapతో check చేయాలి
Godavari Peninsular River కాబట్టి distributaries లేవు
Dakshin Ganga అనే title వల్ల ప్రతి printed basin percentage current అని నిర్ధారించవచ్చు
option_explanations_en: Delta channels and district boundaries can change or be mapped differently.
Correct: it preserves the stable principal bifurcation and dates finer route details.
The Godavari has a major distributary delta.
A cultural title does not validate numerical basin shares.
option_explanations_te: Delta channels, district boundaries change కావచ్చు లేదా differently map చేయవచ్చు.
సరైనది: stable principal bifurcationను preserve చేసి finer routesను date చేస్తుంది.
Cultural title numerical basin sharesను validate చేయదు.
questions.explanation_en: The Godavari has the largest basin among Peninsular rivers and is popularly called Dakshin Ganga or Vridha Ganga. CWC identifies the main lower bifurcation as Gautami and Vasishta; local channels such as Vainateya require a current map for precise route questions.
questions.explanation_te: Godavari Peninsular Riversలో largest basin; Dakshin Ganga/Vridha Ganga అని పిలుస్తారు. CWC main lower bifurcationను Gautami, Vasishtaగా గుర్తిస్తుంది. Vainateya వంటి local channelsకు precise route question అడగాలంటే current map అవసరం.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Match the Godavari relationship: A. Pranahita; B. Kaleshwaram; C. Rajamahendravaram; D. Trimbakeshwar. 1. Lower main-course city; 2. Source-region locality; 3. Wardha-Wainganga tributary system; 4. Pranahita-Godavari confluence context.
questions.question_te: Godavari relationshipను సరిపోల్చండి: A. Pranahita; B. Kaleshwaram; C. Rajamahendravaram; D. Trimbakeshwar. 1. Lower main-course city; 2. Source-region locality; 3. Wardha–Wainganga tributary system; 4. Pranahita–Godavari confluence context.
option_explanations_en: Correct: A–3, B–4, C–1 and D–2.
All four relationships are mismatched.
None of the four is correct.
The hierarchy and place relations are displaced.
questions.explanation_en: Major Godavari tributary systems include Pravara, Manjira, Maner, Pranahita, Indravati and Sabari. Town and pilgrimage-site questions must distinguish a source locality, main-stem city, tributary town and confluence. Bank classification is always made looking downstream.
questions.explanation_te: Major Godavari tributaries: Pravara, Manjira, Maner, Pranahita, Indravati, Sabari. Town/pilgrimage questionsలో source locality, main-stem city, tributary town, confluence వేరు చేయాలి. Bank classification downstream వైపు చూస్తూ నిర్ణయించాలి.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Consider the following statements about Godavari tributary banks: 1. Purna, Pranahita, Indravati and Sabari are placed on the left-bank side in the consolidated table. 2. Pravara, Manjira and Maner are placed on the right-bank side. 3. Pranahita integrates the Wardha-Wainganga system. 4. Bank designation is determined while looking upstream. Which are correct?
questions.question_te: Godavari tributary banks గురించి కింది వాక్యాలను పరిశీలించండి: 1. Consolidated tableలో Purna, Pranahita, Indravati, Sabari left-bank sideలో ఉన్నాయి. 2. Pravara, Manjira, Maner right-bank sideలో ఉన్నాయి. 3. Pranahita Wardha–Wainganga systemను integrate చేస్తుంది. 4. Bank designation upstream వైపు చూస్తూ నిర్ణయిస్తారు. సరైనవి ఏవి?
option_explanations_en: Statement 3 is also correct.
Correct: 1, 2 and 3 are accurate; bank side is determined downstream, so 4 is false.
Statement 1 is also correct, but 4 is false.
Statement 4 makes this combination incorrect.
option_explanations_te: సరైనది: 1, 2, 3 accurate; bank side downstreamగా నిర్ణయిస్తారు కాబట్టి 4 false.
questions.explanation_en: The printed longer lists include local tributaries such as Darna, Sindphana, Kinnerasani, Kadam and Shivna. Their individual origins and confluences require map-level verification; the scored core table retains the best-supported principal bank relationships.
questions.explanation_te: Printed longer listsలో Darna, Sindphana, Kinnerasani, Kadam, Shivna వంటి local tributaries ఉన్నాయి. Individual origins, confluencesకు map-level verification అవసరం; scored core table best-supported principal bank relationshipsను ఉంచుతుంది.

questions.label: Original PYQ-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_en: Which treatment correctly separates stable river geography from changing infrastructure facts?
questions.question_te: Stable river geographyను changing infrastructure facts నుంచి సరిగా వేరు చేసేది ఏది?
options_en: Indravati's tributary relationship, Sileru project status and every allocation figure are equally timeless
Retain Indravati and Sabari-Sileru river-system relationships, but date and source hydropower status, project capacity and interstate allocation
Infer project capacity from the river's length
Treat every project listed in an old edition as currently complete
options_te: Indravati tributary relationship, Sileru project status, ప్రతి allocation figure అన్నీ equally timeless
Indravati, Sabari–Sileru river-system relationshipsను retain చేసి, hydropower status, project capacity, interstate allocationను date, source చేయాలి
River length నుంచి project capacityను infer చేయాలి
Old editionలో listed ప్రతి project ప్రస్తుతం complete అని భావించాలి
option_explanations_en: Infrastructure status and allocations can change even when the river relationship remains stable.
Correct: it separates stable physical geography from dated policy and infrastructure facts.
River length does not determine project capacity.
Completion status requires a current official project source.
option_explanations_te: River relationship stable అయినా infrastructure status, allocations మారవచ్చు.
సరైనది: stable physical geographyను dated policy/infrastructure facts నుంచి వేరు చేస్తుంది.
